description: The source describes annual Spanish road-accident microdata for 2017–2024, with five CSV collections per year covering accident characteristics, drivers, passengers, pedestrians and vehicles. This establishes a road-risk information resource, distinct from live incident feeds and aggregated traffic maps already catalogued. The native deposit is restricted and exposes no file descriptors, so no public download is claimed. The source does not specify record totals, join keys, geographic completeness or the original provider endpoint. Earlier rejection noted an inaccessible DGT route; current inclusion rests on the descriptive native metadata while access and original-source identity limits remain explicit. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
